subject: NovumHealth RFI: SIG control mapping and evidence delivery plan
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novumhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novumhealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: NovumHealth RFI — SIG control mapping + sample artifacts

Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking this RFI; NovumHealth is advancing to the next stage and our InfoSec team needs a SIG-style control crosswalk plus representative evidence for a short sampling set. High-level ask below:

- SIG control mapping (we use the Consensus SIG template); a single-sheet crosswalk (control ID -> Redwood control -> evidence pointer) is ideal.
- Signed SOC 2 report (latest) and ISO 27001 certificate.
- Sample artifacts for controls in the following domains: IAM, Data Encryption, Logging/Monitoring, and Change Management (config snapshots, policy docs, log excerpts).
- A one-hour technical walkthrough (recorded) to clarify any gaps.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the above by 2028-05-30? If you cannot meet that date, please propose a short plan and ETA. Also let us know any controls that require legal redaction or an NDA prior to artifact transfer.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Director, Information Security
NovumHealth

--
Attachment stubs referenced: vendor questionnaire will follow once we agree on scope.
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NovumHealth RFI — SIG control mapping + sample artifacts

Elena,

Appreciate the clear ask — we can meet this. Plan below (high level) and owners:

1) Crosswalk: Ben will produce a SIG->Redwood control crosswalk in CSV/XLSX. (owner: Ben Carter; ETA: 2028-05-24)
2) Attestations: we'll provide the SOC 2 attestation and ISO 27001 certificate (owner: Karthik; ETA: 2028-05-24).
3) Sample artifacts: we'll prepare a small set of redacted artifacts for the four domains you listed. Expect a mix of config screenshots, policy docs, and filtered log excerpts (owner: Ben; ETA: 2028-05-27).
4) Walkthrough: propose 2028-05-26 for a 60-minute session (recorded) — please confirm a time window that morning or early afternoon PT.

A few quick notes:
- We intend to deliver artifacts via a short-lived secure S3 share (links will be access-controlled).
- If any artifacts contain customer-identifying information, we will redact per our data sharing policy; please advise if you need the full unredacted view under an NDA.

If that schedule works, Ben and Karthik will start packaging and will send you the first crosswalk by Friday (5/24).

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@novumhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NovumHealth RFI — SIG control mapping + sample artifacts

Elena / team,

Attaching our initial deliverables and notes (attachment stubs below). Key items:
- Novum_SIG_crosswalk_v1.xlsx: SIG control -> Redwood control -> referenced evidence filename/locator + brief note if evidence is redacted.
- SOC2-Report-Redwood-2027-redacted.pdf: redacted where necessary for 3rd-party vendor blocks.
- ISO27001-Certificate-2026.pdf: scanned cert from our registrar.
- k8s-audit-sample-2028.tar.gz: condensed audit log excerpt (sanitized).

A couple of open questions for the sample artifacts:
1) For the IAM domain, do you prefer sampled user provisioning records or recent access review evidence? We can provide both but may need to redact emails.
2) For encryption, we can provide key management process docs and an operational screenshot of KMS policy. If you need raw key material proof, we'll need to follow a stricter NDA and legal review.

I'll package the crosswalk as an XLSX with per-control evidence pointers. ETA for the remaining artifacts is 5/27 as Laura suggested.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Security Liaison, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs: Novum_SIG_crosswalk_v1.xlsx; SOC2-Report-Redwood-2027-redacted.pdf; ISO27001-Certificate-2026.pdf; k8s-audit-sample-2028.tar.gz
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novumhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, security@novumhealth.com
Date: Thu, 23 May 2028 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NovumHealth RFI — SIG control mapping + sample artifacts

Thanks, Ben — that is helpful. Answers inline: 

- IAM: access review evidence is preferred; user provisioning records are a secondary ask. A couple of redactions are fine (please note what was redacted).
- Encryption/KMS: process docs and KMS policy screenshots are sufficient; we do not require key material. If you can include key rotation logs (sanitized), that would be valuable.

We're available for the walkthrough on 2028-05-26 between 10:00–13:00 PT. Please send a calendar invite (Teams) and a preferred dial-in.

Also attached is our vendor questionnaire for completeness — please fill in the sections related to data residency and encryption.

Elena

--

- 2028-05-24: SOC2-Report-Redwood-2027-redacted.pdf; ISO27001-Certificate-2026.pdf (Karthik Iyer).
- 2028-05-27: artifact bundle for IAM/Encryption/Logging/ChangeMgmt (Ben Carter) — sanitized logs and screenshots.
- 2028-05-26 10:30 PT: 60-minute technical walkthrough (Laura / Ben / Karthik) — Teams invite to follow.

Delivery method: secure S3 share (short-lived presigned links); initial package will be available to NovumHealth security with limited ACL. If Novum needs unredacted artifacts, please confirm and we will route through legal/NDA.

Related links / tracking: HubSpot record HS-345219; S3 share placeholder: https://redwood.app/s3share/novum-health-presigned-placeholder

If nothing else is needed, Ben will send the crosswalk this Friday and Karthik will attach the attestations. Laura and I will host the walkthrough on 5/26.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
